mapper.select: select distinct pos_department from t_pos where pos_company_id = #{companyId} and pos_department is not null and pos_department != '' order by pos_department
mapper.update: update t_pos set pos_status = #{status} where pos_id = #{posId} and pos_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_pos (pos_company_id, pos_publisher_id, pos_title, pos_department, pos_work_city, pos_salary_min, pos_salary_max, pos_experience_required, pos_education_required, pos_job_type, pos_jd_json, pos_status) values (#{companyId}, #{publisherId}, #{title}, #{dept}, #{city}, #{salaryMin}, #{salaryMax}, #{experience}, #{education}, #{jobType}, #{jdJson}, #{status})
mapper.select: select cmp_id as id, cmp_name as name, cmp_city as city from t_cmp where cmp_id = #{companyId} and cmp_status = 1

select pos_id as posId, pos_title as title, pos_department as dept, pos_work_city as city, pos_salary_min as salaryMin, pos_salary_max as salaryMax, pos_experience_required as experience, pos_education_required as education, pos_job_type as jobType, pos_status as status, date_format(pos_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, pos_jd_json as jdJson, pos_process_template_id as templateId, (select ptl_name from t_process_template where ptl_id = p.pos_process_template_id) as templateName, (select ptl_version from t_process_template where ptl_id = p.pos_process_template_id) as templateVersion from t_pos p where p.pos_id = #{posId} and p.pos_company_id = #{companyId}

select count(*) as total, sum(case when t.tal_status in (1,2,4,5,7) then 1 else 0 end) as passed, sum(case when t.tal_status = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as interviewing, sum(case when t.tal_status = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as rejected, sum(case when t.tal_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end) as offered, sum(case when t.tal_status = 5 then 1 else 0 end) as hired from t_process_instance pi join t_tal t on t.tal_id = pi.pin_candidate_id where pi.pin_position_id = #{posId}

select pi.pin_id as instanceId, t.tal_id as talId, u.user_id as userId, ifnull(u.nick_name, u.user_name) as name, ifnull(t.tal_matched_score, 0) as matchScore, (select dict_label from sys_dict_data where dict_type = 'candidate_status' and dict_value = cast(t.tal_status as char) collate utf8mb4_unicode_ci limit 1) as statusLabel, t.tal_status as statusCode, (select psg.psg_name from t_process_stage psg where psg.psg_id = pi.pin_current_stage_id) as currentStage from t_process_instance pi join t_tal t on t.tal_id = pi.pin_candidate_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where pi.pin_position_id = #{posId} order by t.tal_matched_score desc

select s.psg_name as name, s.psg_type as type, s.psg_sort_order as sortOrder from t_pos p join t_process_stage s on s.psg_template_id = p.pos_process_template_id where p.pos_id = #{posId} order by s.psg_sort_order

select t.ptl_id as templateId, t.ptl_name as name, t.ptl_version as version from t_pos p join t_process_template t on t.ptl_id = p.pos_process_template_id where p.pos_id = #{posId} and p.pos_company_id = #{companyId}

select psg_name as name, psg_type as type, psg_sort_order as sortOrder, psg_is_required as required, psg_pass_threshold as threshold, psg_interviewer_config_json as configJson from t_process_stage where psg_template_id = #{templateId} order by psg_sort_order
mapper.insert: insert into t_process_template (ptl_company_id, ptl_name, ptl_position_id, ptl_version, ptl_status) values (#{companyId}, #{name}, #{posId}, 'v1.0', 1)
mapper.select: select max(ptl_id) from t_process_template where ptl_position_id = #{posId}
mapper.update: update t_pos set pos_process_template_id = #{templateId} where pos_id = #{posId} and pos_company_id = #{companyId}
update t_process_template set ptl_name = #{name} where ptl_id = #{templateId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_process_stage (psg_template_id, psg_name, psg_type, psg_sort_order, psg_is_required, psg_pass_threshold, psg_interviewer_config_json) values (#{templateId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{sortOrder}, #{required}, #{threshold}, #{configJson})
